title: Good-level slice decomposition of the flat-convergence remainder (Simon 7.2.4 (1)–(7); steps 2, 4–6 of the parent)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and Ŝ_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (j ∈ ℕ) be integer multiplicity currents (contract IsIntegerMultiplicity, currents GeometricCurrentOn univ), let κ_j (j ∈ ℕ) be measures on ℝ^P, K ⊆ ℝ^P compact and ε > 0. Assume: (FL′) for every open W₀ ⊆ ℝ^P with compact closure (CompactlyContained W₀ univ) there are integer multiplicity R_j ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) and S′_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with C − Ŝ_j − S′_j = ∂R_j for every j and M_{W₀}(R_j) + M_{W₀}(S′_j) → 0; (SL′) for every T ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P), all measures μ, μ′ on ℝ^P that are finite on compact sets, all maps ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P), ξ′ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector) that are a.e. strongly measurable for μ, μ′ respectively, with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x and all (n+1)-covectors α and |ξ′(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ′-a.e. x and all n-covectors α (|·| the Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm), T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all ω ∈ 𝒟^{n+1}(ℝ^P) and ∂T(η) = ∫ ξ′(x)(η(x)) dμ′(x) for all η ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ (L ∈ [0, ∞)), there are currents A_t ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) and B_t ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω) dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ′(η) dμ′, ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) whenever tsupport η ∩ {f = t} = ∅, and M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L · liminf_{h→0⁺} h⁻¹ μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for every open W and every t; (BR′) every integer multiplicity R ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) with M_W(∂R) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure has an integer multiplicity boundary ∂R; (κ) for every r ∈ ℝ, κ_j(B_r(0)) < ∞ for all sufficiently large j. Then there are an open W ⊆ ℝ^P, a compact F ⊆ ℝ^P, a strictly increasing φ′ : ℕ → ℕ, numbers e_i ∈ [0, ∞] with e_i → 0, and currents Ŷ_i, Sr_i ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (i ∈ ℕ) such that K ⊆ W ⊆ F, W ⊆ thickening(ε, K) (Mathlib Metric.thickening: the points at distance < ε from K; empty if K = ∅), and for every i: Ŷ_i is integer multiplicity, ∂Ŷ_i = 0 and spt Ŷ_i ⊆ F; M(Sr_i) ≤ e_i; μ_R(F ∖ W) ≤ e_i for every integer multiplicity representation R of Ŷ_i in ℝ^P (μ_R = R.measure); κ_{φ′(i)}(F ∖ W) = 0; and C(ω) = Ŝ_{φ′(i)}(ω) + Ŷ_i(ω) + Sr_i(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ W.
